basic_details.job_title: NIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Delhi has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post, purely on contract basis, in the DST funded project "Design and Development of Portable VIS-NIR Spectrometer for Detection of Pesticide Content in Fruits and Vegetables Products". The project runs for about 1.5 years and the pay is Rs. 37000/- + 27% HRA. Indian citizens with the required postgraduate or engineering qualification and a valid GATE/NET/National level examination or own fellowship may apply by emailing a detailed CV to [email protected] by 16 November 2026.

vacancy_details.details: The notice advertises one position: JRF – 01. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted by email only, as described in the notice. Send a detailed CV to [email protected] by 16/11/2026. The CV should include:
Date of birth and contact details: mobile number, email and postal address.
Summary of completed/on-going research projects (only relevant to this project).
A statement showing the candidate's strength and compatibility with the project requirements.
Contact details of two referees, and any other information.

For any query, contact Dr. Gyanendra Sheoran ([email protected]), Associate Professor (Physics), Department of Applied Sciences, National Institute of Technology Delhi, Mob.: 7042131946. The notice does not mention an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one position: JRF – 01. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. The essential qualification for the JRF post, as printed, is: Post graduation in Sciences (Physics/instrumentation/any relevant field), or graduation or post-graduation in Engineering/Technology; qualified with valid GATE/NET/National level examination/Own fellowship. Desirable: candidates with experience in dealing with optics/prototyping of instruments, machine learning, 3D imaging, spectral imaging, or proficiency in MATLAB, LabVIEW, Python will be preferred. Age: JRF – 32 years. SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD candidates will get relaxation on qualification and age as per Govt. of India Rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The JRF post carries Rs. 37000/- + 27% HRA. The engagement is purely on contract basis under the DST funded project, and the project duration is about 1.5 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by email only, as described in the notice. Send a detailed CV to [email protected] by 16/11/2026. The CV should include: Date of birth and contact details: mobile number, email and postal address. Educational/professional qualifications. Summary of completed/on-going research projects (only relevant to this project). Publications (only SCI, if any). A statement showing the candidate's strength and compatibility with the project requirements. Contact details of two referees, and any other information. For any query, contact Dr. Gyanendra Sheoran ( [email protected] ), Associate Professor (Physics), Department of Applied Sciences, National Institute of Technology Delhi, Mob.: 7042131946. The notice does not mention an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview through email. The notice does not print an interview date. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF posts has NIT Delhi advertised?
faq.answer: NIT Delhi has advertised one JRF position (JRF – 01) under the DST funded project on a portable VIS-NIR spectrometer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Delhi JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 16 November 2026. The CV must be emailed to [email protected] by that date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Delhi JRF post?
faq.answer: Post graduation in Sciences (Physics/instrumentation/any relevant field), or graduation or post-graduation in Engineering/Technology, with a valid GATE/NET/National level examination or own fellowship.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Delhi JRF post?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age for JRF as 32 years. SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD candidates get relaxation as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Delhi JRF?
Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Delhi JRF post?
faq.answer: Email a detailed CV with the particulars listed in the notice to [email protected] by 16/11/2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NIT Delhi JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely on contract basis under the DST funded project, which has a duration of about 1.5 years.

faq.question: Q8. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.answer: Indian citizens meeting the qualification may apply. Experience in optics, instrument prototyping, machine learning, 3D imaging or spectral imaging, or proficiency in MATLAB, LabVIEW or Python, is preferred.
